question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

To get the _____ idea you need to read through the paragraph first.
solution:
The correct answer is "**overall**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **altogether**: including everything or everyone; in total.
 
• **overall**: taking everything into account.
 
• **internal: **of or situated on the inside.
 
• **inside: **the inner side or surface of something.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, **overall **is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
 
• **Example**: T*he client was impressed with the team's **overall **__performance on the project.*
 
 

**The correct sentence is**: *To get the __**overall **__idea you need to read through the paragraph first.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **altogether**: सब कुछ या सभी सहित; कुल मिलाकर।
 
• **overall**: सब कुछ ध्यान में रखते हुए।
 
• **internal: ** के अंदर या अंदर स्थित।
 
• **inside: ** किसी चीज का भीतरी भाग या सतह।
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, **overall **is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
